/-- A function whose domain's cardinality is infinite and strictly greater than its codomain's
has a fiber with cardinality strictly greater than the codomain. -/
theorem infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : ℵ₀ ≤ #β) :
    ∃ a : α, #α < #(f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  simp_rw [← succ_le_iff]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₀ hβ le_rfl (by rwa [isRegular_aleph0.cof_eq])
    exact ⟨a, ha.trans' (succ_le_of_lt hα)⟩
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f (succ #α) (succ_le_of_lt h) (hα.trans (le_succ _))
      ((lt_succ _).trans_le (isRegular_succ hα).2.ge)

/-- A function whose domain is infinite and has cardinality strictly greater than its codomain's
has an infinite fiber. -/
theorem exists_infinite_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Infinite β] :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  have hβ := infinite_iff.1 ‹Infinite β›
  simp_rw [infinite_iff]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₀ hβ le_rfl (by rwa [isRegular_aleph0.cof_eq])
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h hβ
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans ha.le⟩

/-- A function with infinite codomain whose domain has strictly greater cardinality
has an infinite fiber. -/
theorem exists_infinite_fiber' {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Infinite α] :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a}) :=
  have : Infinite β := infinite_iff.2 <| (infinite_iff.1 ‹Infinite α›).trans h.le
  exists_infinite_fiber f h

/-- A function whose domain is uncountable and has cardinality strictly greater than its
codomain's has an uncountable fiber. -/
theorem exists_uncountable_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Uncountable β] :
    ∃ a : α, Uncountable (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  have hβ : ℵ₁ ≤ #β := by simpa [← aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← succ_le_iff] using ‹Uncountable β›
  simp_rw [← aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← succ_le_iff, succ_aleph0]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₁ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₁ hβ aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le
      (by rwa [isRegular_aleph_one.cof_eq])
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le.trans hβ)
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans ha.le⟩

/-- If an infinite type `β` can be expressed as a union of finite sets,
then the cardinality of the collection of those finite sets
must be at least the cardinality of `β`. -/
theorem le_range_of_union_finset_eq_univ {α β : Type*} [Infinite β] (f : α → Finset β)
    (w : ⋃ a, (f a : Set β) = Set.univ) : #β ≤ #(range f) := by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_le] at h
  let u : ∀ b, ∃ a, b ∈ f a := fun b => by simpa using (w.ge :) (Set.mem_univ b)
  let u' : β → range f := fun b => ⟨f (u b).choose, by simp⟩
  have v' : ∀ a, u' ⁻¹' {⟨f a, by simp⟩} ≤ f a := by
    rintro a p m
    have m : f (u p).choose = f a := by simpa [u'] using m
    rw [← m]
    apply fun b => (u b).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨⟨-, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩, p⟩ := exists_infinite_fiber u' h
  exact (@Infinite.of_injective _ _ p (inclusion (v' a)) (inclusion_injective _)).false

theorem exists_uncountable_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : Uncountable β) :
    ∃ a : α, Uncountable (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  simp_rw [← aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← succ_le_iff, succ_aleph0] at hβ ⊢
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₁ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₁ hβ aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le
      (by rwa [isRegular_aleph_one.cof_eq])
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le.trans hβ)
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans ha.le⟩

theorem exists_uncountable_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : Uncountable β) :
    ∃ a : α, Uncountable (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  simp_rw [← aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← succ_le_iff, succ_aleph0] at hβ ⊢
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₁ hβ aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le
      (by rw [isRegular_aleph_one.cof_eq]; exact hα.trans aleph0_lt_aleph_one)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (hβ.trans' aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le)
    rw [← succ_le_succ_iff, succ_aleph0] at hα
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans (succ_le_of_lt ha)⟩

theorem exists_infinite_fiber' {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hα : Infinite α) :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a}) :=
  exists_infinite_fiber f h <| infinite_iff.2 <| (infinite_iff.1 hα).trans h.le

/-- If `κ` is a regular cardinal with `κ ≤ #β` and `#α < #β`, then some fiber of `f : β → α` has
cardinality at least `κ`. -/
theorem exists_le_mk_fiber_of_isRegular {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) {κ : Cardinal}
    (hκ : κ.IsRegular) (hκβ : κ ≤ #β) (h : #α < #β) : ∃ a : α, κ ≤ #(f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  rcases lt_or_ge #α κ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f κ hκβ hκ.aleph0_le (by rwa [hκ.cof_eq])
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (hκ.aleph0_le.trans hκβ)
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans ha.le⟩

/-- A function whose domain's cardinality is infinite but strictly greater than its domain's
has an infinite fiber. -/
theorem exists_infinite_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : Infinite β) :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  simp_rw [infinite_iff] at hβ ⊢
  exact exists_le_mk_fiber_of_isRegular f isRegular_aleph0 hβ h

/-- A weaker version of `exists_infinite_fiber` that requires codomain to be infinite. -/
theorem exists_infinite_fiber' {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hα : Infinite α) :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a}) :=
  exists_infinite_fiber f h (by
    rw [Cardinal.infinite_iff] at hα ⊢
    exact hα.trans h.le)

/-- A function whose domain's cardinality is uncountable but strictly greater than its domain's
has an uncountable fiber. -/
theorem exists_uncountable_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : Uncountable β) :
    ∃ a : α, Uncountable (f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
  simp_rw [← aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← succ_le_iff, succ_aleph0] at hβ ⊢
  exact exists_le_mk_fiber_of_isRegular f isRegular_aleph_one hβ h
